from collections import deque
import sys

def dinic2(nH,hadj,others,x,y,limit):
    if x==y:return limit
    n=nH+len(others)
    adj=[[] for _ in range(n)]
    to=[];cap=[]
    # local refs
    adj_app=adj # no
    for u,d in enumerate(hadj):
        au=adj[u]
        for v,c in d.items():
            if c>0:
                e=len(to)
                if c>limit:c=limit
                au.append(e);to.append(v);cap.append(c)
                adj[v].append(e+1);to.append(u);cap.append(0)
    sbase=nH
    for i,(C,V) in enumerate(others):
        s=sbase+i
        e=len(to);c=C if C<limit else limit
        adj[x].append(e);to.append(s);cap.append(c)
        adj[s].append(e+1);to.append(x);cap.append(0)
        as_=adj[s]
        for v in V:
            e=len(to)
            as_.append(e);to.append(v);cap.append(limit)
            adj[v].append(e+1);to.append(s);cap.append(0)
    level=[-1]*n
    it=[0]*n
    flow=0
    old=sys.getrecursionlimit()
    if old<n+100:sys.setrecursionlimit(n+1000)
    while flow<limit:
        # bfs
        level=[-1]*n
        level[x]=0
        q=deque([x])
        while q:
            u=q.popleft();nl=level[u]+1
            for e in adj[u]:
                if cap[e]>0:
                    v=to[e]
                    if level[v]<0:
                        level[v]=nl;q.append(v)
        if level[y]<0:break
        it=[0]*n
        # dfs
        def dfs(u,f):
            if u==y:return f
            au=adj[u];i=it[u];la=len(au);nl=level[u]+1
            while i<la:
                e=au[i];v=to[e]
                if cap[e]>0 and level[v]==nl:
                    ce=cap[e]
                    r=dfs(v, f if f<ce else ce)
                    if r:
                        cap[e]-=r;cap[e^1]+=r;it[u]=i
                        return r
                i+=1
            it[u]=i
            return 0
        while flow<limit:
            f=dfs(x,limit-flow)
            if not f:break
            flow+=f
    if old<n+100:sys.setrecursionlimit(old)
    return flow
